channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Five pets in Hampshire who are looking for loving new homes
item.description: Several pets in Hampshire are looking for forever homes, including at the RSPCA Solent branch in The Stubbington Ark.

item.title: Preschool promises improvements as Ofsted says children 'not challenged enough'
item.description: Foundry Lane, a Southampton Preschool, has promised improvements will be made after receiving mixed feedback from an Ofsted inspection.

item.title: 'The best food I've ever tasted' - at AO by Daniel Rogan restaurant
item.description: If AO by Daniel Rogan does not achieve Southampton's first Michelin star, then I don't know what will.

item.title: Woman died after banging head in kitchen fall
item.description: A woman died within 24 hours of falling over in her kitchen and banging her head, an inquest heard.

item.title: Tesco store plan set for approval despite more than 600 objections
item.description: Controversial plans for a new Tesco store in a seaside village which have attracted more than 600 objections are set to be approved.

item.title: The edge of the New Forest country pub with cracking carvery and curry
item.description: It's the country pub with cracking carveries and curries which welcomes muddy boots and waggy tails after New Forest walks.

item.title: Council will look again at traffic light change after backlash over congestion
item.description: Southampton City Council will review changes made to traffic lights on a major junction at Romsey Road, after mounting pressure about congestion.

item.title: Resident claims college students causing 'daily nightmare' in parking feud
item.description: Furious Eastleigh residents have told of college student parking causing blocked roads, missed care visits for the vulnerable and obstructed ambulances.

item.title: Former teacher found with thousands of indecent images of children
item.description: An ex-teacher from Southampton had thousands of indecent images of children and has now been sentenced

item.title: Itchen Bridge lights to finally turn from blue to red and white after campaign
item.description: Southampton’s skyline is set for a dramatic transformation after the city council confirmed the Itchen Bridge will soon be changed to red and white during Saints matchdays.
